2610.07270.title: Does the Model Use the Feature? Separating Steering from Mechanism in LLMs
2610.07270.paper_summary: Internal features in LLMs are often interpreted as mechanisms when they track a concept and their manipulation changes a related behavior. Yet steering can push a feature far outside its natural range, where its effects need not reflect the model's own computation. We examine this inference and propose an empirical contract whose tests evaluate features at values observed on natural inputs. One test copies a feature's value from an input that shows a behavior into a matched input that does not (installation) or the reverse (removal); the other restores the feature after an upstream edit (downstream rescue). Installation measures how far the feature suffices for the behavior; removal and downstream rescue measure how much the model uses it. Applied to three kinds of representations, the two strengths separate sharply. The published unknown-entity latent strongly steers knowledge abstention, yet installing observed values from either published latent into matched prompts transfers only a small fraction of the natural known--unknown abstention contrast. Dense known--unknown directions show opposite asymmetries between installation and removal in Gemma and Llama, and how fully a released subject--verb agreement feature set reproduces and restores the behavior depends on how its values are written into the model. Tracking a concept and steering a behavior therefore do not by themselves show that the model uses a feature, and each conclusion holds only for the intervention tested.
2610.07270.paper_summary_zh: 內部特徵在大型語言模型（LLMs）中常被解釋為機制，當它們追蹤一個概念並且其操作改變了相關行為時。然而，操控可能會將一個特徵推到其自然範圍之外，在那裡其效果不必反映模型自身的計算。我們檢視這一推論並提出一個實證契約，其測試評估在自然輸入上觀察到的特徵值。一個測試將一個顯示行為的輸入中的特徵值複製到一個不顯示該行為的匹配輸入（安裝），或反之（移除）；另一個則在上游編輯後恢復該特徵（下游救援）。安裝測量該特徵對行為的足夠程度；移除和下游救援則測量模型對其的使用程度。應用於三種表示方式時，這兩種強度明顯區分。已發表的未知實體潛變量強烈驅動知識的放棄，然而，將從已發表潛變量觀察到的值安裝到匹配提示中僅轉移了自然已知-未知放棄對比的一小部分。密集的已知-未知方向在Gemma和Llama中顯示出安裝和移除之間的相反不對稱，而釋放的主語-動詞一致性特徵集如何完全再現和恢復行為則取決於其值如何寫入模型。因此，追蹤一個概念和操控一個行為本身並不顯示模型使用了某個特徵，且每個結論僅對所測試的干預成立。
2610.07270.author: Tong Che et.al.
